'''March 2000 Utica tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Wizards of the Coast store, Utica, MI on 1 March 2000. It is known from Clint Prong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d298">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-02-wizards-of-the-coast-utica-mi-3-1-2000d298/ wizards-of-the-coast-utica-mi-3-1-2000], DeckTech (Clint "Gold93" Prong, 2 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-02-wizards-of-the-coast-utica-mi-3-1-2000d298/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 1 March 2000
* '''Site:''' Wizards of the Coast store, Utica, MI
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 15
